headline: Transrail Lighting plans ₹600 crore QIP to fund growth
hook: Power EPC player eyes fresh capital infusion
summary: Transrail Lighting is planning a ₹600 crore Qualified Institutional Placement (QIP) to support its expansion plans. The company aims to achieve 20–22% revenue growth by FY27 and is targeting ₹10,000–11,000 crore in new order inflows. To reach its targets, the firm needs to secure 25–28% growth over the next six months. This capital raise is intended to strengthen its balance sheet for upcoming power transmission projects.
why_it_matters: Capital expansion may improve project execution capacity for the power sector.
